# Nav

Vertical navigation for the sidebar of an application: items with an icon, a label and a count, in groups with
headings; the current page is selected. Put it in the `sidebar` of AppShell.

**Interaction**: a `nav` landmark. Items are links (with `href`) or buttons, reached with `Tab` in order; `↑` /
`↓` move to the previous or next item and `Home` / `End` to the first or last, skipping disabled items. Hover and
press add the shared state layer; `Tab` focus shows the focus ring inside the item, so a scrolling sidebar does
not cut it off; the current item has the subtle selected background and `aria-current="page"`, and when it
changes to an item outside the visible part of the sidebar, the sidebar scrolls it into view. `collapsed` shows
icons only, with the label in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. Inside AppShell, choosing an item closes the
sidebar drawer of narrow screens.

**Category**: Patterns · **Common uses**: The main navigation in the sidebar of an application; the sections of a settings area

## Import

```ts
import { Nav } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Items with icons and counts, then a group with a heading. `value` is the key of the current page and
`onSelect` receives the key of the chosen item. In an application, Nav goes in the `sidebar` of AppShell.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { EmptyState, Nav, type NavGroup, type NavItem, SplitView, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'

const ITEMS: readonly (NavItem | NavGroup)[] = [
  { key: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
  { key: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: 'inbox', count: 4, countTone: 'accent' },
  { key: 'projects', label: 'Projects', icon: 'folder', count: 12 },
  {
    type: 'group',
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      { key: 'members', label: 'Members', icon: 'users' },
      { key: 'reports', label: 'Reports', icon: 'chart' },
      { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' },
    ],
  },
]

const LABELS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  home: 'Home',
  inbox: 'Inbox',
  projects: 'Projects',
  members: 'Members',
  reports: 'Reports',
  settings: 'Settings',
}

export function Basic() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState('inbox')
  return (
    <SplitView
      asideWidth="sm"
      aside={
        <Stack padding={2}>
          <Nav items={ITEMS} value={page} onSelect={setPage} />
        </Stack>
      }
    >
      <EmptyState icon="file-text" title={LABELS[page] ?? page} description="The page goes here" />
    </SplitView>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Links

Items with `href` are real links, so they can be opened in a new tab. With `onSelect`, plain clicks call it
instead of following the link: pass your router's navigation there.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { EmptyState, Nav, type NavItem, SplitView, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'

const LINKS: readonly NavItem[] = [
  { key: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: 'dashboard', href: '/overview' },
  { key: 'activity', label: 'Activity', icon: 'activity', href: '/activity' },
  { key: 'billing', label: 'Billing', icon: 'wallet', href: '/billing' },
]

export function Links() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState('overview')
  return (
    <SplitView
      asideWidth="sm"
      aside={
        <Stack padding={2}>
          <Nav aria-label="Account" items={LINKS} value={page} onSelect={setPage} />
        </Stack>
      }
    >
      <EmptyState icon="file-text" title={`Opened /${page}`} />
    </SplitView>
  )
}
```

### Collapsed

`collapsed` shows icons only; the labels appear in tooltips and stay the accessible names. Inside AppShell,
Nav follows the sidebar and needs no `collapsed` of its own.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Inline, Nav, type NavGroup, type NavItem, Stack, Switch, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

const ITEMS: readonly (NavItem | NavGroup)[] = [
  { key: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
  { key: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: 'inbox', count: 4, countTone: 'accent' },
  { key: 'projects', label: 'Projects', icon: 'folder', count: 12 },
  {
    type: 'group',
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      { key: 'members', label: 'Members', icon: 'users' },
      { key: 'reports', label: 'Reports', icon: 'chart' },
      { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' },
    ],
  },
]

const LABELS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  home: 'Home',
  inbox: 'Inbox',
  projects: 'Projects',
  members: 'Members',
  reports: 'Reports',
  settings: 'Settings',
}

export function Collapsed() {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(true)
  const [page, setPage] = useState('home')
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Inline gap={2} align="center">
        <Switch aria-label="Collapsed" checked={collapsed} onChange={setCollapsed} />
        <Text>Collapsed</Text>
      </Inline>
      <Inline gap={4} align="start">
        <Nav items={ITEMS} value={page} onSelect={setPage} collapsed={collapsed} />
        <Text tone="secondary">Current page: {LABELS[page] ?? page}</Text>
      </Inline>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## States

### Disabled item

A disabled item is faded and skipped by `Tab` and the arrow keys.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { EmptyState, Nav, type NavItem, SplitView, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'

const WITH_DISABLED: readonly NavItem[] = [
  { key: 'files', label: 'Files', icon: 'folder' },
  { key: 'shared', label: 'Shared with me', icon: 'share', count: 2 },
  { key: 'archive', label: 'Archive', icon: 'archive', disabled: true },
]

export function Disabled() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState('files')
  return (
    <SplitView
      asideWidth="sm"
      aside={
        <Stack padding={2}>
          <Nav aria-label="Files" items={WITH_DISABLED} value={page} onSelect={setPage} />
        </Stack>
      }
    >
      <EmptyState icon="folder" title={page === 'files' ? 'Files' : 'Shared with me'} />
    </SplitView>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly (NavItem \| NavGroup)[]` | Items and groups, in order. Items outside groups come first, usually (Home, Inbox). | — | Yes |
| `value` | `string \| null` | Key of the current page: the item gets the selected style and `aria-current="page"`. `null` when no item is current. | — | No |
| `onSelect` | `(key: string) => void` | Called with the key when an item is chosen. On items with `href`, plain clicks call it instead of following the link (for client-side routing); clicks with a modifier key or the middle button open the link as usual. Without `onSelect`, links are followed by the browser. | — | No |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | Icons only: the labels show in tooltips on the right and remain the accessible names; group headings are hidden. Inside the sidebar of AppShell, it follows the sidebar when omitted. | — | No |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the navigation landmark; "Main" when omitted. Give each Nav of a page its own name. | — | No |
| `testId` | `string` | Test id, rendered as `data-testid`. | — | No |
| `id` | `string` | `id` of the `nav` element. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### NavItem

An item of Nav: a page of the application.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | Unique key, passed to `onSelect` and compared with `value`. | — | Yes |
| `label` | `string` | Text of the item; also the tooltip and the accessible name when Nav is collapsed. | — | Yes |
| `icon` | `IconName` | Icon name. Give every item an icon, or none: a collapsed Nav shows a dot for items without one. | — | No |
| `count` | `number` | Count shown at the end (CountBadge); nothing is shown when it is 0 or omitted. | — | No |
| `countTone` | `'neutral' \| 'accent'` | Tone of the count: `accent` for unread items and to-dos, `neutral` for plain counts. | `'neutral'` | No |
| `href` | `string` | Address of the page: the item is a real link (`<a href>`), so it can be opened in a new tab. Without it, the item is a button that calls `onSelect`. | — | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disabled: shown faded, cannot be focused or chosen. | — | No |

### NavGroup

A group of Nav items with a heading.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'group'` | Marks the entry as a group. | — | Yes |
| `key` | `string` | Unique key of the group; the label is used when omitted. | — | No |
| `label` | `string` | Heading of the group; hidden when Nav is collapsed (screen readers still read it). | — | Yes |
| `items` | `readonly NavItem[]` | Items of the group (groups are not nested). | — | Yes |

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

118 values, listed on the [Icon](Icon.md#types) page.
